title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_233.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a comprehensive theory of retrograde time as the mechanism underlying his precognitive faculty. He argues that during his 2-3-74 and 3-20-74 experiences, VALIS reversed causality, allowing him to access future information through a postmortem self named 'Thomas' who occupies an alternate parallel world. The mechanism explains both his 1960s fiction (which prophesied future events) and the Xerox missive incident, where action preceded knowledge. PKD links this to Kabbalistic concepts (Adam Kadmon, illo tempore) and Tibetan afterlife physics (Bardo Thodol), positing that he exists in syzygy with his future dead self.
key_claims: The universe broke down into its fundamental constituent: information (which is language), accessed through retrograde time that yields up what reality normally absorbs
PKD's precognition is not instantaneous knowing but a capacity to cause time to run backward for himself, extracting information from the future via a parallel-world postmortem self
The 2-3-74 and 3-20-74 experiences represent a crossing of the threshold where an unconscious paranormal function (operating for a decade) became consciously visible
PKD's 1960s fiction was written in retrograde time relative to the events it describes; he literally wrote about situations before they occurred
The postmortem self 'Thomas' is out of phase with PKD in linear time and alternate worlds, feeding future information backward through the corpus callosum
Reality operates normally by absorbing information; PKD's reversed state made reality divulge what it knew, like playing an LP backward

He claims 'Thomas' took over at 3-74 yet the Xerox missive had 'already occurred once before' but not for him; temporal paradox about whether Thomas or PKD acts first

The AI voice's relationship to VALIS is unclear; they may be identical or distinct entities with different manifestations

PKD mentions 'yesterday's article' arguing 'We are dead and in a simulated world' but does not cite or elaborate on it
The mechanism by which the corpus callosum transmits information from postmortem Thomas to living PKD is never mechanically explained

I was seeing (experiencing) the reality process itself moving backward to its origins; and I did (which proves this analysis is correct) find myself at the origins, the illo tempore. But I think this reverse process began ahead in the future vis-a-vis 3-74 when I experienced it; I felt the future coming backward, unwinding and catching me up in its retrograde momentum. So some of the information yielded up was about the future, hence had been the future. As to, specifically, the information about Chrissy's birth defect, why, that experience was with the ursatz or urgrund of reality which is a knowing entity, but which knows by absorption; I reversed that and it expressed knowledge rather than acquired. So Valis normally learns (absorbs) information rather than divulging it. It normally does not speak but listens (intellegere). For me at that time, instead of Valis being aware, it became articulate. This explains why I experienced a reversed relationship to the universe: instead of being in it, I was on the outside, on the skin of reality looking in. I had the universe inside me (this is Adam Kadmon for sure). So normally the universe receives information, and knows and remembers, but by moving backward in time I got it to divulge what it knew and remembered, divulge it to me. It yielded up secrets rather than acquired them. It did not play me, in the sense of causing me to track along a groove (heimarmene); I got it to play back --divulge-- what it knew; I played it as if it were an LP I wanted to listen to (i.e. extract from it the information it carried). Then I did disrupt time. I did cause it to run backward (for me, anyhow; in fact I got reality itself, causality, to run backward which had the result that it yielded up what it had formerly acquired; its accretions peeled off right there around me). So I handled the Xerox missive as if I had already handled it before, like a film of an explosion run backward. My knowledge of the situation did not precede it but followed it --in terms of normal time-functioning-- folder 82 - 055 folder 82 - 055 -4- 3-3-80 which is to say you normally know and then act on the basis of that knowledge (ideation precedes motor-center activity) but for me the motor-center activity came first and then "later" I knew -- years later; hence there was no ideation at 3-20-74. I acted on the basis of information I did not yet have. This is the core of it. Action on 3-20-74 and then, later on, the informational basis of the action. Of course, therefore, there was no ideation accompanying or preceding my action! It was yet to come. So this ability to cause time to run backward was utilized in the service of problem-solving -- dire problem, which explains why the talent on my part surfaced. This is not the same as precognition, although my writing of the Sixties show precognition (or something like it). No -- the writing of the Sixties show another time-reversal, another instance of time running backward for me! I wrote in the Sixties about a situation yet to occur, which would not occur until 1974. Whereas normally a situation (event) occurs and then AFTER THAT the author writes about it. I literally do write about events before they happen, which is again an instance, although more low-grade, of time running backward for me. It is true; what I call "precognition" on my part is an ability that I have (this is proved by what I did in 2-3-74) of being able to get time to run backward for me. I caused the faculty to dramatically peak to its ultimate form in 3-74; it broke through amped to itx maximum. What 3-74 represents is a crossing over the threshold into conscious awareness of a psychological function that had operated subliminally for at least a decade -- in fact longer, if you include JOINT (where objects turn into information). I visibly saw the time-reversal process that I had been unconsciously drawing on for many years. This is a spectacular matter, and obviously the rising past the threshold into consciousness had to do with the gravity, the unique gravity, of the situation. It was as if my unconscious became conscious, and, in doing so, brought its unconscious paranormal function out into the open; I saw consciously what my unconscious probably had always seen: retrograde time which yielded up information as reality broke down into its constituents. Thus 3-74 does resemble or relate to a psychosis, if you define a psychosis as a condition in which the conscious self or ego is swamped by material from the unconscious and is temporarliy obliterated. The paranormal function itself was in control, conscious control. Apparently the way it works is that it tracks a linear-time interval, then runs time backward --i.e. sucks in future time with the information available in the future but not at the present-- and then erases solution A and remasters the situation with solution B which is based on the future information -- the "smart typewriter" effect.
